description: Yapay zeka , bitki koruma sistemleri , tarımsal verimlilik ve biyoloji anlamında çalışmalar yapıyoruz . Buradaki hedefimiz çiftçilerin karşılaştıkları zorlukları en aza indirmek ve daha verimli bir üretimi desteklemek .
summary: Climate change, irregular and unconscious use of chemical pesticides,deteriorating soil health and natural disasters, etc. for some reason, today's farmers are facing risky October decisions.Our project is a web-based and offline agricultural decision support tool that combines NASA's Earth observation data (SMAP, ECOSTREES,Landsat/MODIS NDVI, NASA power climate data, SRTM slope) with local soil analysis results and the farmer's own data priorities.By entering the location coordinates, users automatically pull temperature, precipitation and reference evaporation data from the NASA POWER API.The farmer enters his own soil analysis (soil moisture, surface temperature, irrigation for the last 30 days ,NDVI, water storage tendency, slope, percentage of organic matter, soil ph, nitrogen, potassium, zinc, iron in the soil, salinity ratio) into the system.He asks the farmer to determine his priorities and restrictions.In the system, which responds to all the values provided by the farmer, defines the values as good/attention/problem. Starting from the most important ones, it identifies the problems of the soil and the region and offers solutions.Precipitation frequencies of the region, soil analysis, etc. by determining its characteristics, it provides disaster analysis of the region and recommendations for reducing disaster risks occurrence.At at the same time, it detects harmful insects and gives a recipe for a natural insecticide suitable for that insect.
details: The project is an innovative and versatile agricultural decision support tool that can work offline, developed in order to combat the negative effects of climate change on agriculture. Comprehensive NASA Earth observation data such as SMAP, ECOSTRESS, GPM, Landsat/MODIS, NASA POWER, GRACE and SRTM were integrated into the system with local soil analysis and farmer priorities.By analyzing the field's moisture, temperature, rainfall, and nutrient values, it presents the most suitable crop rotation strategies in a comparative manner. It has critical features such as simulating climate scenarios, monitoring parcel-based vulnerabilities, calculating disaster risks, and determining plant suitability based on soil data. Additionally, it recognizes harmful insects through in-device image segmentation without requiring any internet connection.The application, which proposes ecological pest control methods and natural pesticide recipes, does not replace agricultural expertise but supports local decisions with scientific data. Modern tools such as Octml5, CSS3, Vanilla JavaScript, NASA POWER API, Canvas API and Web Crypto API have been used in the development process, and the system can run on any mobile device or computer that can run a standard web browser without the need for additional hardware. Taking into account the Internet restrictions in rural areas, the reality that farmers may not have a technical background, and the importance of human judgment, the team has designed the interface to be extremely intuitive; a reference without depending on cloud-based servers.By establishing a modular architecture that can be updated with JavaScript and runs in browser memory, they have managed to make space data accessible and sustainable for everyone.
